source_revision.repo_news_entry: [2025/12/22] The PerLTQA dataset has been updated. It mainly fixed the inconsistency issues in the dataset. (verbatim from README.md 'News' section)

relationship_support: events.Characters references social_relationship IDs (AVAILABLE, verified full scan zh). dialogues IDs are suffixed event IDs (e.g. '4_0_0#0' -> event '4_0_0') giving an implicit events->dialogues link (AVAILABLE, positional convention, not a separate explicit field). Memory-level parent_ids/equivalent_to/conflicts_with/superseded_by: NOT_PROVIDED_BY_SOURCE (full scan, all 141 characters, all languages).
known_limitations: The dataset is NOT Chinese-only despite the task's initial framing: raw/Dataset/ ships zh (original, 8,593 questions, fully usable), en (v1, 1,905 questions), and en_v2 (Dec-2025 update, 1,905 questions) releases. BOTH English releases have null Answer / missing Reference Memory / missing Memory Anchors for 1,548/1,905 (81.3%) of their non-profile questions (full scan, this stage) -- the English translations are usable only for the 357-item profile subset in either revision. The claimed Dec-2025 'fixed the inconsistency issues' update did not fix this in English; it changed only the memory file's top-level container type (list->dict).
The en_v2 update also introduced one character-name mismatch between the QA file and the (restructured) memory file that did not exist in en/zh (full scan, this stage).
82 duplicate (character, Question-text) pairs exist within the zh QA file (full scan) -- a minor source-side duplication, not something this normalization introduced or removed.

Memory Anchors character-offset spans resolve against the referenced unit's raw text for 20,937/23,697 (88.4%) of spans in zh (full scan); the remaining 11.6% are the source's own [-1,-1] 'anchor text not found verbatim' sentinel, not something this stage invented or repaired.

social_relationship/events/dialogues IDs are scoped PER CHARACTER, not globally unique across the 141-character corpus -- MAMBench memory_id usage must compose (character, native_memory_unit_id), never the bare native ID alone.

No explicit timestamp field beyond events' free-text 'Creation Time'/'Last Accessed Time' strings (not machine-parseable dates in all cases) -- classified TIMESTAMPED_PARTIAL, not TIMESTAMPED_ABSOLUTE.

Only one GitHub snapshot (commit 8d9e19868e239740ef701e603ec205cd581f221b) was inspected; the pre-Dec-2025 revision was not separately re-audited (per task instruction to use the current revision, not the old one).
preprocessing_actions: manifests/preprocessing_manifest.json (zh: full flatten of profile/social_relationship/events/dialogues into memory_records.jsonl + all 4 QA sections into task_records.jsonl, zero drops; en/en_v2: profile-only normalization, non-profile sections explicitly logged as excluded per-character in exclusion_manifest.json, never silently dropped)
exclusion_reasons: Zero exclusions in the zh (primary) release -- full scan of all 8,593 questions / 7,521 memory units found zero malformed records, zero null answers, zero empty answers. 192 en/en_v2 non-profile per-character sections are logged (not silently dropped) as BROKEN_SOURCE_TRANSLATION in manifests/exclusion_manifest.json.
